fortified_stave.description: Full-thickness reinforced gate stave with shouldered crown and a hand-hewn bowed face.

fen_deck_plank.description: Thick adzed deck board with hewn long edges, eased end grain and localized threshold wear.

lod2.description: Explicit distant deck retopology: small adzed corner shoulders retain the fitted bearing envelope without enlarging drainage gaps.

frontier_cinderfen_corner_access.name: Cinderfen corner landing and courtyard stair access

contract.assembly_note: Two perpendicular wall ends join the west and south openings. The supported diagonal gangway carries the stair socket into the courtyard so the lower stair entry clears both curtain bases. Rotate the complete assembly for each keep corner. No visible rail crosses any socket.

reused_authored_construction.scope: Original Cinderfen stone/stave/fixing cages and material fields, fitted into a new pentagonal corner assembly; no stock primitive construction. Visual acceptance is recorded separately.
